'''Ngoni''' is a [[Bantu language]] of [[languages of Mozambique|Mozambique]]. It is not an [[Nguni language]], but only retains the name. It is only marginally mutually intelligible with [[Ngoni language (Tanzania)|Tanzanian Ngoni]], with about 60% cognate vocabulary; speakers of the two languages resort to a third language, such as Swahili, to communicate.<ref>[https://iso639-3.sil.org/sites/iso639-3/files/change_requests/2020/2020-018.pdf]</ref>
A [[lexicostatistic]]al study found only 24% of core vocabulary.<ref>L. M. Miti (1996) Subgrouping Ngoni varieties within Nguni: A lexicostatiscal approach. ''South African Journal of African Languages'', vol. 16 issue 3.</ref>
